name: Fall 2026

reviewed.ratingText: Never, Please No More Like This Ever
reviewed.review: All right, so we’ve gone from starting this season’s reviews, and the first one is a terrible VRMMORPG where you can’t log out, but then you can die and it matters, but it also seems like it doesn’t matter. I don’t know if the concept is here, but the main guy appeared to be kind of a turd who was in the middle of some quest and tried to screw it over for VR… I’m not watching more of this.

So from hearing others, this is a manga that I didn’t read, but it’s like 20 years old, something like that, and it’s based around telephone cards, which were the way that everybody communicated and used very extensively in the 90s through the mid 2000s. I think they did a good job of taking it and moving it forward, making it an even weirder thing. The other thing I’m getting the vibe of is I would call it a semi-nostalgia show from the era where the manga was made, so I definitely get these big 2005 vibes from the character design, art styling, production, etc. Doesn’t hurt that Satelight is the primary anime studio doing this. So overall, I’m curious to see where the episodes go, and hopefully they picked it up as an anime project from a long forgotten manga because the manga is good, and hopefully the anime will be good too.
